name: audit-update-source-trust-toctou
title: Harden install.py update source-trust TOCTOU window
description: A-017 (PR #143) added the installer source-trust gate but accepted the time-of-check/time-of-use window as a residual: an attacker who swaps source_root or its .git between the ownership check and the subsequent git and install.py invocations can still influence what runs. The gate also follows a symlinked .git via stat and treats any existing .git entry as proof of a repository. Close or measurably shrink that window in installer.management._source_checkout, and decide the symlinked-.git handling explicitly, without weakening the existing A-017 refusals.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Ordered 1 in the P2 band: ahead of the quality-guidelines.md landing cluster (documented in .trellis/tasks/08-08-trellis-backlog-hygiene/record.md), which it is not a member of -- it reads that file as a contract but no requirement or acceptance criterion writes it. The order is explicit rather than absent because an absent order is read as 0, which ranked this task first by accident rather than by decision. Security hardening lands before documentation consolidation.
